notes: ramp is throttled by the same AcceptBudget the restart recovery is measured under
readiness (ramp done / restart consistent) is read from the server’s own socket count, not the load generator’s self-report
time-to-consistent = first channel patch received after the kill (reconnect + resubscribe + delivery)
the consistency probe only publishes after the kill, so ramp.consistent is empty by construction — the ramp measures acceptance, the restart measures recovery
DB load proxy: shedAttempts is the count of connect attempts the AcceptBudget refused before accepting in that phase — every one of those never reached a query/snapshot path
client swarm split across 10 OS processes so the load generator's own event loop is never the bottleneck being measured
